notes.title: MiDiO! Version 0.8.6.2
notes.notes:
[p]It's been a little more than a week since the release of [b][u]MiDiO! Early Access![/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is a small post launch update containing some fixes that should make the game more stable[/p][p]and performant, as well as a few new placeable objects (and object varieties)!
Some of which were suggested or even donated by community members! (❤ ω ❤)

Thank you everyone who has supported, bought and played the game so far, as well as submitted feedback and posted on the [b][u][url="https://discord.gg/nynaJFfVCb"]Official MiDiO! Discord[/url]!
[/u][/b]And of course thank you everyone for the positive reviews! I strive to make a bug free, fun and memorable experience for everyone. So please keep bearing with me as we continue through the rougher early stages of the game![/p][p][/p][h3][u]The Demo will receive an update soon![/u][/h3][p][/p][p]Here is a summary of the changes in update 0.8.6.2:[/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]NEW:[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]30+ new objects and variations![/p][/*][*][p]5 new types of light objects[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554551/a00cacce3a758f3cb671bf5ed36dcda928af61aa.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Rumi[/b] now don't get confused anymore when the walls disappear[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rumi[/b] can now better navigate rooms[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eri [/b]shouldn't get stuck in tight places anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing a certain key when controlling a [b]Rumi[/b] doesn't cause it to leave the plane of existence anymore[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]Rumi[/b] doesn't join a [b]Dio[/b] anymore if the player doesn't own at least one of him/her[/p][/*][*][p]It's not possible to control un-owned [b]Rumi[/b] anymore[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kibo[/b] adds himself to the players collection if not already owned, as he always stays by the players side. No matter what.[/p][/*][*][p]Some objects now have a slightly more final name[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some objects missing or having the wrong categories[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to changing material colors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential crash when starting the game related to online features (e.g. Steam Workshop)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential crash when the game is about to close[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some objects not being moveable after being placed[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations with lumen enabled[/p][/*][/list]
